items.title: 科学、技术与创新部长普恩：尼泊尔应效仿以色列发展研究与创新
items.titleEn: Nepal should follow Israel's footsteps in research and innovation: Minister Pun
items.status: DeepSeek 正文分析 · 待 Codex 核验
items.statusEn: DeepSeek article analysis · pending Codex review
items.summary: 据《Radio Nepal》报道，科学、技术与创新部长马哈比尔·普恩在加德满都以色列大使馆举办的“以色列网络与人工智能”活动上表示，尼泊尔应效仿以色列，通过投资研究与创新建设强劲繁荣的经济。他称赞以色列以约占国内生产总值百分之五的研发投入，把沙漠国家发展为农业、科学与技术领域的全球领先者。普恩称，尼泊尔新政府首次将资本支出的百分之一用于研究与创新，并计划在人工智能、网络安全、无人机、农业和生物医学工程等领域建立创新中心。以色列驻尼泊尔大使什穆利克·阿里耶·巴斯强调以方在网络安全和人工智能方面的经验，并表示将通过知识共享和机构伙伴关系加强双边科技合作。报道称，活动有四名来访的以色列代表团成员发言。以上均为会上发言与计划表述，报道未提供具体实施时间表或立项细节。
items.summaryEn: Radio Nepal reports that Minister for Science, Technology and Innovation Dr. Mahabir Pun, speaking at an 'Israel Cyber and AI' program at the Israeli Embassy in Kathmandu, said Nepal should follow Israel's footsteps and invest in research and innovation to build a strong and prosperous economy. He praised Israel for turning a desert country into a global leader in agriculture, science and technology by investing around five percent of GDP in research and innovation. Pun said Nepal's new government has allocated one percent of capital expenditure for research and innovation for the first time and is planning innovation centers in areas including artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, drones, agriculture and biomedical engineering. Israeli Ambassador Shmulik Arie Bass highlighted Israel's cybersecurity and AI experience and reaffirmed commitment to cooperation through knowledge-sharing and institutional partnerships. The report says a four-member visiting Israeli delegation made presentations. These are remarks and plans announced at an event; no implementation timeline or project details were disclosed.
items.analysis: 若上述表态转化为实际政策，可能影响尼泊尔科研经费分配和数字技术人才培养，进而间接影响本地科技企业与电信、互联网行业的长期供给能力；但当前仅为部长在活动上的计划性表述，尚无客户或企业受到直接影响。下一步应核实尼泊尔新政府关于资本支出百分之一用于研究与创新的预算文件，以及所称创新中心是否已获正式批复、主管机构和选址。证据缺口包括：活动主办方仅来自单一报道、计划是否已列入正式预算、以及“创新中心”的具体范围与时间安排，均未在报道中说明。
items.analysisEn: If the minister's remarks translate into policy, they could affect Nepal's research funding allocation and digital skills pipeline, with indirect long-term effects on local tech firms and telecom/internet sector capacity; at present these are event remarks about plans, so no customer or company is directly affected. The next step is to verify the new government's budget document on allocating one percent of capital expenditure to research and innovation, and whether the stated innovation centers have received formal approval, with responsible agencies and locations. Evidence gaps include reliance on a single report of the event, whether the plans are in an official budget, and the specific scope and timing of the innovation centers, none of which the report specifies.

items.title: 总理沙阿启程对印度进行为期两天的国事访问
items.titleEn: Prime Minister Shah leaves for two-day state visit to India
items.status: DeepSeek 正文分析 · 待 Codex 核验
items.statusEn: DeepSeek article analysis · pending Codex review
items.summary: 据《Radio Nepal》报道，总理巴伦德拉·沙阿应印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪邀请，乘尼泊尔航空公司定期航班前往新德里，展开为期两天的国事访问。报道称，访问期间沙阿计划拜会印度总统德劳帕迪·穆尔穆，并与莫迪举行代表团级会谈，双方预计讨论贸易、过境、投资、能源、互联互通和基础设施建设，并签署涵盖教育、卫生、农业、体育、灾害管理和人力资源开发等领域的谅解备忘录。访问还包括为加强互联互通和能源合作的已完工项目举行揭幕仪式，以及为新项目奠基。访问期间将举办尼泊尔—印度商业论坛，沙阿计划向印度商界介绍尼政府吸引投资的政策与举措。上述行程为计划安排，报道未提及访问成果。
items.summaryEn: Radio Nepal reports that Prime Minister Balendra Shah left for New Delhi on a two-day state visit at the invitation of Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, departing on a regular Nepal Airlines flight. The report says Shah is scheduled to pay a courtesy call on Indian President Droupadi Murmu and hold delegation-level talks with Modi, with the two sides expected to discuss trade, transit, investment, energy, connectivity and infrastructure development and to exchange MoUs covering education, health, agriculture, sports, disaster management and human resource development. The visit also features inauguration of completed projects aimed at strengthening connectivity and energy cooperation, plus foundation-stone ceremonies for new projects. A Nepal-India Business Forum will be held, where Shah plans to outline the government's investment-attraction policies to the Indian business community. These are planned events; the report does not describe outcomes.
items.analysis: 若访问中的互联互通与投资议题取得进展，可能影响尼泊尔与印度之间的通信、过境和数据/能源基础设施合作环境，进而间接影响电信运营商和企业的跨境连接成本与投资预期；但当前仅为已宣布的行程计划，尚未产生对客户或企业的直接影响。下一步应核实访问结束后发布的联合声明或签署的谅解备忘录清单，确认其中是否包含通信、数字或互联互通相关条款。证据缺口包括：报道未提供任何已签署文本、项目名称或投资金额，也未说明商业论坛的具体成果，且所有预期成果均来自出访前的计划性描述。
items.analysisEn: If the connectivity and investment agenda advances during the visit, it could shape the cross-border communications, transit and energy infrastructure environment between Nepal and India, indirectly affecting telecom operators' and businesses' cross-border connectivity costs and investment expectations; however, these are announced travel plans, with no direct impact on customers or companies yet. The next step is to verify the post-visit joint statement or the list of signed MoUs to confirm whether any communications, digital or connectivity provisions are included. Evidence gaps include the absence of any signed text, project names or investment amounts, no details of Business Forum outcomes, and the fact that all expected results come from pre-departure planning descriptions.
